terms.gloss: take out; take or scoop out
terms.comment: “Core” and “deseed” are expressed with ordinary objects and verbs rather than unsupported one-word technical coinages. Ordinary Latin verbs cover the actions: scooping is expressed with eximere plus the spoon as an instrument; no separate unsupported kitchen neologism is required.

phrases.english: Scoop out the avocado flesh with a spoon.

sources: The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
